title: Press to Gather - Configurable
author: Tic0311 and CamilleBC
summary: Hold B / Circle to gather nearby harvestable resources, or press O. Choose your controller button and a 10–200 m distance in the Mod Settings. Defaults: 0.6-second hold and 20 m.

file.name: Press to Gather - Configurable
file.description: Added support for more wild plants, including Cave Fungus, Comfrey and Green-Gilled Mushroom.
